Setting.Name: DaemonModules###PrometheusExporter
Setting.Description: Prometheus metrics exporter daemon module. Exposes a /metrics HTTP endpoint on the configured port.

Setting.Name: Daemon::PrometheusExporter::Port
Setting.Description: TCP port for the Prometheus metrics exporter (default: 10111).

Setting.Name: Daemon::PrometheusExporter::Bind
Setting.Description: IP address the Prometheus metrics exporter binds to (default: 127.0.0.1). Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.
